title: manuscript-guard methods review
description: The methods of studies of the same question, read at the design stage: for each study, why it is similar and, field by field, the words of its stored copy that say what it did; an appraisal of each method against a published methodological standard, which is an agent's or a person's proposal; and the author's decision to adopt, adapt or reject it. G7 looks for each passage in the study's stored copy under literature/sources/; G12 holds each appraisal to a standard and a domain, each decision to a person, and each method adopted to a citation in the plan.

question.description: The question the studies were chosen for: the plan's, in a sentence.

searched.description: How the studies were found, so that a reader can repeat the search.

standards.description: The citation key of each standard the appraisals name, and any standard the built-in table does not hold, with its domains.

with.description: What was searched: `manuscript-guard search`, or a registry by name.

searched_on.description: The day it was searched. Not `on`, which YAML reads as true.

id.description: A standard of the built-in table (data/method_standards.yaml), or one of the project's own.

citekey.description: Where the standard is published, by the key the plan cites it under.

name.description: For a standard the built-in table does not hold: its name.

domains.description: For a standard the built-in table does not hold: its domains, as it names them.

citekey.description: The study, by its citation key; its stored copy is literature/sources/<citekey>.*

similar.description: What it shares with this study.

why.description: Why it was chosen, in a sentence.

label.description: What the field is, where it is `other`.

summary.description: What the study did, in a few words, for the table.

passage.description: The study's words that say what it did, copied from its stored copy. Words left out are marked [...] or an ellipsis, and each piece is looked for in order.

locator.description: Where in the study, e.g. 'Methods, Exposure, p. 3': precise enough for a co-author to find it.

appraisal.description: The method judged against a published standard: one judgement, or several.

standard.description: The standard it is judged against, by its id. G12 warns where there is none, or it is not known.

domain.description: The standard's domain the judgement is of, as the standard names it.

concern.description: How far the method departs from the standard in that domain.

says.description: The judgement, naming the risk: 'risk of immortal time: exposure defined after cohort entry'.

proposed_by.description: Who proposed it: an agent or a model by name, or a person.

choice.description: Whether this study's plan takes the method as it is, changed, or not at all.

decided_by.description: The person who decided, by name. An agent may propose an appraisal; only a person decides.
